title: Supreme Court pulls up Ayurvedic doctor for failure to provide medical care to child rape victim
description: The Supreme Court on Friday pulled up an Ayurvedic doctor for failing to provide medical care to a child rape victim in Ghaziabad in March. A Bench of Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana was hearing a plea by the child's father raising serious lapses in investigation and the medical response in the case."A child is brought before you, and you are so merciless, you did not provide medical care.
